race.comment: RUSSIAN SUMMER (10) earns top billing off a stronger last-start effort than the bare fifth suggests, charging home at Townsville after beginning awkwardly and finishing only a length and a half from Cifonelli in Class 5. The weight relief and easier assignment from that provincial race strengthen his case, while his broad record around 1250m gives him enough substance despite KHABALOV having beaten him there. KHABALOV (3) is the clear danger after running second in the same Townsville race, beaten half a length after a slow beginning, and he brings a proven this-track-and-distance profile for a leading stable. CORPULENT (8) resumes off southern form that included a Kembla Grange Mdn win before a Wyong Class 1 fifth, and his first look at 1250m is the main reservation. May need the run but worth watching the market. NOVELA (4) has been in the market at his last couple of starts but hasn't made an impression, last start running fifth at Innisfail. Expecting a strong run in this field.
